classes.name: info_particle_system

description: Soundscape / ambient / particle entity classes for Geppetto Desktop (hammer-soundscapes-particle-preview-backend). Additional registry file: load with EntityRegistry.LoadAdditional on top of the core Source-1 set. Source-1 keyvalue names (soundscape, radius, message, health, pitch, effect_name, start_active, cpoint1..cpoint7). startsilent / loop on ambient_generic are Geppetto extension keys (int 0/1) — Source ignores unknown keys. The preview-parameter keys on info_particle_system (emissionrate, lifetime, speed, spread, startsize, endsize, gravity) are the keys ParticleSystemRef.ToPreviewParticleSystem reads.
name: hammer-soundscapes
